title: Password change, reset and recovery are delegated to the realm's Keycloak account console
description: The blueprint contributes the `credentialSelfService` capability by resolving and exposing the realm's Keycloak account console (`<issuerBaseUrl>/realms/<realm>/account`) as the sole self-service surface for password change, password reset, account recovery, and MFA enrolment. No project route renders a credential-change form of its own. The realm-config record declares an `accountConsoleUrl` field that the discovery client verifies on boot (the URL responds with a 2xx from an unauthenticated GET); a realm whose account console is disabled or unreachable is refused at boot with `KEYCLOAK_ACCOUNT_CONSOLE_UNREACHABLE`. The project exposes a project-authored `getCredentialSelfServiceUrl()` helper that returns the resolved account console URL for the current realm; a project page linking to self-service reads that helper rather than hard-coding a URL.
rationale: A capability declaration without a delegated-self-service contract lets a consumer bind against `credentialSelfService` and render a self-service link that either resolves to nothing or lands on a broken realm surface. Naming the realm-config field and the boot-time verification is what makes the capability observable at apply time.
